title: Exporting You Data - Job Tracker
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Are you ready to take control of your job search data?  In this video, we’ll show you how to easily export your Job Tracker data for multiple purposes! Whether you're transitioning to Google Sheets or just need to keep a record of your job applications, we’ve got you covered! 

What We Will Cover:
- How to export your Job Tracker activity-based report 
- Step-by-step guide to save as a CSV file 
- How to view and analyze your exported data in programs like Mac Numbers 
- The difference between event export and data export 
- How to export archived jobs and what to expect 
- Future functionality updates for enhanced exporting 

Questions Answered in This Video:
- How can I export data from my Job Tracker? 
- What is the difference between activity-based and data exports? 
- Can I use my exported data in Google Sheets? 
- What information is included in the exported reports? 
- How do I export archived jobs?
